newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Gold Mines of Australia lifts gold find.
newsitem.headline: Gold Mines of Australia lifts gold find.

text.p: Gold Mines of Australia Ltd (GMA) said on Wednesday it had made a significant upward revision in the gold resource at its Reedy prospect in Western Australia.
"A two-month drilling programme will begin in July to further define the resource," GMA said in a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange.
"This will be followed by a mining assessment with a view to commencing a feasibility study for a new mining operation by early September," the company said.

The additional indicated and inferred resource comes from the extension to the Noa two system located below the existing pit within the Reedy prospect and totals 59,375 ounces of gold from 247,495 tonnes of ore, grading 7.5 grams of gold a tonne, with a cut-off grade of 1.2 grams a tonne, GMA said.
Pending the results of the feasibility study, GMA said it expected to begin development in late 1997/98 (July-June), with production commencing at the start of the 1998/99 financial year.
"We are extremely encouraged by these results which will allow detailed mine planning for operations in 1998/99 while exploratory drilling of the NOA deposit continues", GMA said.
The northern area of Noa two system is yet to be drill tested at depth and as such the Noa desposit remains open ended both along strike and down dip, the company said.
